# @fourlyn/apple-foundation-models

> React Native / Expo SDK for Apple Foundation Models (Apple Intelligence LLMs): on-device SystemLanguageModel and Private Cloud Compute. TypeScript-first; iOS 26+ (many features iOS 27+); requires an Expo development build or bare React Native with Expo Modules (not Expo Go).

Start with AGENTS.md: a single-file integration guide with install steps, API cheat sheet, OS matrix, pitfalls and error codes.
